caption: The drawing features a single object, which is an axe with a wooden handle and a metal head. The handle is curved and colored in shades of light to medium brown, with visible wood grain patterns that create a sense of texture. The axe head is a dark reddish-brown color, indicating a rusty or worn metal appearance, and has an angular shape with a flat top and a blade that widens towards the bottom. The object is centered against a plain, off-white or beige background with no other elements present. At the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten inscription that reads “William H. Edwards. 390-L. Del.” in fine script.
title: Post Axe
